# Ben Walder Healing Arts

> Structural Integration (often called Rolfing), integrative manual therapy, craniosacral, visceral and neurovascular work, plus herbal and nutritional consultations, for people in North County San Diego with chronic pain, old injuries, post-surgical or post-accident recovery, posture problems and stress held in the body. Practitioner: Ben Walder, about 15 years of study and practice. By appointment.
